title: The GeoMAP (v.2022-08) continent-wide detailed geological dataset of Antarctica
citation: Cox, S. C., Smith Lyttle, B., Elkind, S., Smith Siddoway, C. S., Morin, P., Capponi, G., et al., 2023. The GeoMAP (v.2022-08) continent-wide detailed geological dataset of Antarctica. PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482. Described in: A continent-wide detailed geological map dataset of Antarctica, Scientific Data 10, 250, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02152-9

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.statement: The PANGAEA dataset page states CC-BY-4.0.

notes: The QGIS archive (GeoPackage, EPSG:3031). scripts/outcrops_geomap.py reads the geological units table for the Byrd Group outcrops of the A–A′ section.
limitations: Mapped at 1:250 000 (locally finer); 'known geology' of exposed rock, not interpreted sub-ice geology. Age ranges (ABSMIN_MA, ABSMAX_MA) are coarse: the whole Byrd Group is given 485–541 Ma.
